appearance.trunks_and_branches: procedural fence skeleton with staggered levels, varied azimuths, elbows and unequal forks
appearance.crowns: dense seeded mixed leaves on branch sides plus top/bottom caps; every leaf touches a fence
appearance.leaf_palette: oak + birch for broadleaf proxies; spruce + oak for conifer proxies
appearance.bounds: supplied height and horizontal crown radius
appearance.dimensions: heights supported by LiDAR/DSM where available; crown radii, counts and branch forms remain estimated

world_verification.check: All cells of touched chunk sections and total chunk coverage verified
world_verification.untouched_chunks: Copied from previously verified full-park world

survey.surface_gaps: Preserved as nodata; building/bridge coverage gates apply; no interpolation

classified_vegetation.limitation: Classifications can contain errors; clustered canopy centres are not surveyed stem locations.

limitations: DSM-minus-DTM is a canopy envelope proxy; DSM may include other objects. Mapped vegetation masks and structure exclusions reduce this ambiguity.
Canopy centres inferred within woodland, widths, branches, understorey density and unspecified species are visual estimates.
Mapped named species use Minecraft block/shape proxies; nearby planning species labels do not establish individual tree identity.
Composite survey dates vary; foliage is a summer visual reconstruction, not a complete current arboricultural survey.
